It leaves behind a protective layer that shields against corrosion, wear, and harsh environmental exposure. Safe for all military grade metals, including carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum alloys, this non-toxic, biodegradable solution meets the highest standards of operational durability. Suitable for both manual application and large immersion baths, it can be reused across multiple cleaning cycles, maximizing efficiency while minimizing waste.
